svg.title: Target Scale6 path through an out-of-order core
svg.desc: An explicit register dependency connects the Scale6 record load to the property access. Standard fetch, decode, rename, issue, AGU, LSQ, translation and cache structures retain ordinary execution semantics. A separate retirement-only update route must carry committed predictions to the LLC, including for private hits. Squashed operations cannot enqueue refreshes.
svg.text: Target Scale6 path through an out-of-order core
Architecture target only: request binding exists for legacy ReuseBind; the Scale6 commit channel does not.
A REAL WORD FROM THE EDGE STREAM
checked example; not an already-implemented opcode
CPU stages are not a shortcut around memory ordering
I0 / I1 keep their ordinary replay and exception state
Only the oldest completed, non-squashed instruction retires
Scale6 target: implement and measure, do not infer
Native latency, bandwidth, backpressure and drain behavior are not supplied by the cache_sim request clock.
